emotional_progression: quiet focus (s1) -> ease (s2) -> concentration (s3a) -> hope (s3b) -> warmth (s4) -> calm endurance (s5) -> joy (s6a, s6b)
narrative_structure: Establish (Nadia lights the first lantern at dawn) -> journey (down to the river) -> giving (the lantern is set afloat and watched) -> gathering (marigolds in the market) -> weather (rain, umbrella) -> release (the sky lantern is lifted and let go at dusk).
note: The visible character (Nadia, DEMO-CHAR-002) is project-local and is NOT carried in character_resolutions: the P1-006 project model resolves registry identities only through an explicit identity policy, and this demonstration character is deliberately never registered in the global character registry. Her binding lives in character-bible.json and in every shot record of shot-list.json, validated by runtime/character_consistency.py. The script and breakdown are DRAFT, awaiting user approval (see script-breakdown.md); no visual asset has been generated from them.

pacing.beats_per_minute: measured from real narration durations at assembly time

premise: A short vertical photorealistic story: Nadia follows one lantern from dawn to dusk — lighting it, carrying its light to the river, setting it afloat, gathering flowers, standing through rain, and finally letting a sky lantern rise — the same character, recognizably herself, in six scenes and eight genuinely moving shots.

scenes.description: Establishing: Nadia on the rooftop terrace at dawn, lighting the round paper lantern.
Movement: Nadia walks down the old stone steps toward the river, morning light on the water.
Giving and watching: close-up on her hands setting the floating lantern afloat, then close-up on her face watching it drift.
Interaction: Nadia lifts a woven basket of marigolds in the morning market.
Weather: rain in the market; Nadia opens her bamboo umbrella.
Closing: Nadia lifts the sky lantern overhead, then releases it into the dusk sky.

shot_direction.direction: Rooftop terrace, dawn, river and rooftops below; Nadia lights the lantern with a match.
Stone steps to the river, morning light, hair and shirt moving with the stride.
Close-up on hands; Nadia sets the floating lantern on the water and lets it go.
Close-up on Nadia's face; hope; the floating lantern glowing on the water beside her.
Market street, warm daylight; Nadia lifts the basket of marigolds with both hands.
Market street in rain; Nadia opens the bamboo umbrella; wet cobblestones, warm shop light.
Rooftop at dusk; Nadia lifts the sky lantern overhead with both hands.
Rooftop at dusk; Nadia releases the sky lantern, arms lowering, watching it rise.
